name: What is included in Alpha-Plumbing Services' repiping estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is included in Alpha-Plumbing Services' repiping estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our whole-home repiping estimate includes a comprehensive breakdown of all costs associated with the project. This covers labor, the chosen piping materials (PEX or copper), fittings, necessary permits, and clean-up. We ensure transparency, so you understand exactly what you are paying for, with no hidden fees. The estimate will be provided after a thorough assessment of your home's specific plumbing needs and structural layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: Alpha-Plumbing Services' repiping estimate includes labor, chosen materials, fittings, permits, and clean-up, with no hidden fees.
